title: Weapons
tagline: Walked into the dark, and never came back.
about: At 2:17 one morning, seventeen kids from the same third grade class run out of their homes and vanish.

    StartersCafeteria pepperoni pizza squaresSeventeen empty desks in third grade. Sheet-pan pizza cut in squares.How to make it500g bought pizza dough2 tbsp olive oil250ml pizza sauce250g mozzarella, grated100g sliced pepperoni salami1 tsp dried oreganoOil a large baking tray and press the dough out to the edges, then rest it for 10 minutes.Spread with the sauce, scatter over the cheese, pepperoni and oregano.Bake at 230°C on the lowest shelf until the base is crisp and the cheese bubbles.Cut into neat squares and serve.Wellness check tater tots with ranchMarcus insists on a wellness check. Crisp potato gems and buttermilk ranch.How to make it1kg frozen potato gems125ml buttermilk125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp chives, chopped1 tbsp dill, chopped1 garlic clove, crushed1 lemonWhisk the buttermilk, mayonnaise, herbs, garlic and a squeeze of lemon into a ranch dressing.Spread the gems on lined trays and bake at 220°C, shaking once, until deep golden.Salt well and serve with the ranch.Main trayAunt Gladys's sloppy joesAunt Gladys drops in on the principal. Saucy beef mince on soft buns.How to make it600g beef mince1 tbsp olive oil1 brown onion, diced1 green capsicum, diced2 garlic cloves, crushed250ml tomato sauce1 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp yellow mustard1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce6 soft burger buns6 slices of American cheeseBrown the mince in the oil, breaking it up.Add the onion, capsicum and garlic and cook until soft.Stir in the tomato sauce, sugar, mustard and Worcestershire and simmer until thick and glossy.Toast the buns, add a slice of cheese and pile on the filling.Pennsylvania Dutch chicken pot pieArcher carries Matthew home. Chicken and vegetables under flaky pastry.How to make it700g chicken thigh fillets, diced40g butter1 brown onion, diced2 carrots, diced2 celery sticks, diced3 tbsp plain flour500ml chicken stock125ml thickened cream1 cup frozen peas2 tsp thyme leaves1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed1 egg, beatenBrown the chicken in half the butter and lift it out.Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the rest of the butter, stir in the flour, then the stock and cream.Return the chicken with the peas and thyme, simmer until thick, then tip into a pie dish.Lay over the pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200°C until puffed and deep golden.Rest for 5 minutes and serve.PuddingLights-out chocolate pudding cupsOut the front door at 2:17 am. Dark chocolate custard and whipped cream.How to make it600ml milk100g caster sugar30g cornflour25g cocoa powder2 egg yolks100g dark chocolate, chopped1 tsp vanilla extract200ml thickened cream, whipped4 chocolate wafer biscuits, crushedWhisk the sugar, cornflour, cocoa and yolks with a little of the milk until smooth.Heat the rest of the milk, whisk it in and stir over medium heat until thick and bubbling.Take off the heat, stir in the chocolate and vanilla and pour into 4 cups.Chill until set, then top with cream and crushed wafers.DrinksChocolate milk in the cartonWater won't help me, says Gladys. Ice-cold and drunk through a straw.How to make it4 x 300ml cartons of chocolate milk4 paper strawsChill the cartons until icy.Hand them out with a straw each.A brown-bag nip from USA LiquorsMrs. Gandy is on leave.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
